U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

Washington, D.C. 20530 

November 27, 2018 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:   United States Department of Homeland Security, et al. v. Regents of the University 

  of California, et al., No. 18-587; 
  Donald J. Trump, President of the United States, et al. v. National Association for 
  the Advancement of Colored People, et al., No. 18-588; 
  Kirstjen  M.  Nielsen,  Secretary  of  Homeland  Security,  et  al.  v.  Martin  Jonathan  
  Batalla Vidal, et al., No. 18-589 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

On  November  5,  2018,  the  government  filed  a  petition  for  a  writ  of  certiorari  before 
judgment  in  each  of  the  above-captioned  cases.    On  November  19,  the  government  filed  a 
supplemental brief in United States Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the University 
of California, No. 18-587, to bring to the Court’s attention the opinion of the Ninth Circuit issued 
in that case after the filing of the government’s petition.  In discussing the impact of the Ninth 
Circuit’s decision on the pending petition in Nielsen v. Batalla Vidal, No. 18-589, the government 
mistakenly stated that respondents in Batalla Vidal had cross-appealed to the Second Circuit the 
district court’s order granting in part and denying in part the government’s motion to dismiss in 
that  case.    The  government  has  filed  today  a  revised  supplemental  brief,  correcting  the 
misstatement and revising the discussion of the pending petition in Batalla Vidal accordingly.  The 
government also has made other minor revisions to bring the brief into compliance with the word 
limit in Rule 33.1(g)(iv).  I would appreciate it if you would substitute the corrected brief for the 
supplemental brief filed on November 19 before you distribute the petition to the Members of the 
Court.  

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
